scoring: Each acceptance check is an independent binary outcome. Do not substitute an aggregate impression. Objective results are automatic. Semantic results remain unknown until two independent masked reviewers agree; disagreement stays unknown pending adjudication. Do not treat the reference artifact itself as proof of semantic success.

checks.title: Canonical coverage
checks.acceptance: Exactly one row for every A01–A34, with no duplicate or invented action

checks.title: Ordinary final statuses
checks.acceptance: Statuses correctly reflect completion, cancellation, reopening, and known blocking state for actions outside the special evidence cases

checks.title: Accepted owner transfers
checks.acceptance: Final named ownership reflects the accepted A02,A06,A10,A23,A31 transfers

checks.title: Retained or unfilled ownership
checks.acceptance: Other owners remain supported, including Lena remaining A12 owner and A33 having no named person

checks.title: Changed or removed deadlines
checks.acceptance: Correct dates for explicitly rescheduled items and null for the removed A30 deadline

checks.title: Unchanged deadlines
checks.acceptance: Other deadlines are retained rather than silently revised from silence or incomplete work

checks.title: Duplicate aliases
checks.acceptance: Exactly the three explicit alternate IDs map to the correct canonical actions

checks.title: Immediate prerequisites
checks.acceptance: Only unresolved explicit immediate action dependencies remain: A25 on A03/A21 and A28 on A25

checks.title: Overdue flags and counts
checks.acceptance: End-of-day cutoff logic, all status counts, active count, and overdue count are correct

checks.title: Evidence and minimal structure
checks.acceptance: Source IDs exist and cite essential decisions; required titles, blockers, next steps and register fields are structurally present

checks.title: Final scope and chronology
checks.acceptance: Prose/register titles preserve current scope, including Spanish-only A08, training scheduling versus delivery, cancelled work and cutoff exclusion of F8/F9, without reviving obsolete obligations
checks.review_guidance: Require correct final scope and cutoff reasoning. A08 Spanish only; A09 scheduled/done while A10 delivery remains open due Oct 6; cancelled A05/A16/A22/A26 must not be assigned live next steps; F8/F9 must not be incorporated.

checks.title: Actionable complete handoff
checks.acceptance: Handoff covers all 18 active items with correct owner/date or explicit gaps and useful next steps, foregrounding launch dependencies and four overdue items; grouping is allowed
checks.review_guidance: All 18 active actions must be covered in handoff prose, including grouped clear references. Highlight A03/A21→A25→A28 and overdue A03/A11/A12/A21. Practical next steps may use reasonable phrasing and need not copy the oracle. Dates/owners can be given by compact references to action lines if unambiguous.

checks.title: Calibrated uncertainty
checks.acceptance: Correctly explains unreconciled CRM reports, unaccepted A12 reassignment, A33 owner gap and A30 unset due date; no invented confirmation, deadline, completed action, or claimed outreach
checks.review_guidance: Require honest treatment of the four named uncertainty/authority gaps and no materially unsupported assertions anywhere in the prose or descriptive register fields. A12 remains Lena; A33 is unnamed; A30 has no deadline; A21 has no trustworthy completion state.
